title: Settings
subtitle: System settings
adsHelp: Free customers: native ads in Games, Trackers (Active and Pinned), and History, plus an optional rewarded ad for 1 extra tracker until it finishes. Premium never loads ads. Each section has its own switch. The rewarded unit is separate: configure tracking_slot, amount 1, and backend SSV verification. Debug uses test ads with the local backend only. Production requires your Android App ID, ad units, consent and SSV configuration before turning off test mode. No automatic ads in details or notifications. Frequency counts cards; short lists have one ad at the end. Android picks up changes when refreshing subscription data.
operationsHelp: The interval automatically updates watched games. The cache reuses data when browsing games. Props caching never delays new or final statistics. Saving or reloading makes no API calls; changes apply within 5 seconds. Quotas may limit the requested frequency.
pollingOff: Automatic polling is disabled in server configuration.
operationsError: Unable to read operation status. Reload to retry.
invalidNumber: Enter a whole number in range
providerHelp: Applies to new games and picks. Existing trackers retain their original provider and may consume its quota until settled. Individual statistics depend on the API plan.
providerConfirmHelp: New picks will use the selected provider. Existing picks retain their original provider and both may continue consuming requests.
